label: Closed-collection rootedness of actual grounding
definition: Over the #505 Profile, a collection S of candidates is ground-closed at w (GroundClosedActual m w S) when every member of S is an actual concretum at w and every actual concrete ground at w of a member of S is itself in S. ClosedGroundingCollectionsRooted m w holds when no ground-closed collection is both nonempty and without an actual root (ActualRoot: an actual concretum with no actual concrete ground at w); in Lean, every ground-closed collection all of whose members have an actual concrete ground is empty. Ordinary meaning: if you collect actual concrete things together with every actual concrete thing that gives being to any of them (in the selected direct relation), and keep doing so, the collection must contain something to which no actual concrete thing gives being. Such a member may still have an abstract or unmodelled ground: the closure is over actual concrete grounds only. Orientation example (not warrant): a lamp lit by a wire powered by a generator turned by a falling river; collecting each supplier of each member, the collection is rooted only if it reaches something nothing in it supplies. Counterexamples to the condition (formal only): a pure endless descent n+1 grounds n (Control.pureRegress) and a pure cycle with nothing outside it. Non-counterexamples: an endless descending chain all of whose members are also directly grounded by one root (Control.limitGrounder, a direct root grounder despite its name), and a cycle grounded by a root (Control.rootedCycle). A foundation reached only through intermediaries, with no direct edge from the root to the chain (an omega+1 order under direct grounding), violates it (Control.mediateFoundation); a mediate or transitive reading of grounds would need its own bridge. Distinguished from well-foundedness (STMT-ACTUAL-GROUNDING-WF), which says every nonempty collection, closed or not, has a member with no ground inside it: well-foundedness implies the condition (closedRootedOfWF) but not conversely. Distinguished from asymmetry (no two actual concreta ground each other), which it does not imply, and from the existence of some actual root, which it implies only with inhabitedness and excluded middle (actualRootOfClosedRooted). Structural properties: it imposes no transitivity, asymmetry, irreflexivity or finite-path condition on grounding.
note: Analyst framework definition, attribution deferred (#310). It is the weakest no-regress condition that the coverage routes of the stage-one join consume. It is not the borrowed-reality principle itself: that principle quantifies over all suppliers (NoWhollyBorrowedCollection, over every modelled actual supplier), and yields this condition only under the open bridge that actual concreta are supplied only by concreta (ActualSuppliersOfConcretaConcrete; closedRootedOfBorrowed; without the bridge, Control.abstractSupplier). It is relative to the profile's selected direct relation, which is not identified with efficient causing (DEF-PRESENT-ESSE-SUPPORT); whether any real relation satisfies it is open. Dependencies: DEF-ACTUAL-GROUNDING-WF for ActualConcrete, the ActualConcreteGround and ActualRoot predicates of the brute-root vocabulary. Generalizing from ordinary supply chains to metaphysical sustaining is an explicit open bridge. Sourced readings (Aquinas's reduction of what is by participation to what is by essence; Cameron 2008 on foundations reached through intermediaries, which under direct grounding is the mediate-foundation model and violates this condition) are unread leads, not attributions.
